args.stdin: SELECT product_sku, record_path, brand, product_name, properties FROM product_variants WHERE LOWER(brand) = LOWER(:brand) AND LOWER(product_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || :product_name_search || '%');

SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp JOIN product_variants pv ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE LOWER(pv.brand) = LOWER(:brand) AND LOWER(pv.product_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || :product_name_search || '%') AND pvp.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = :cleaner_type)) AS has_cleaner_type, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp JOIN product_variants pv ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE LOWER(pv.brand) = LOWER(:brand) AND LOWER(pv.product_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || :product_name_search || '%') AND pvp.property_key = 'volume' AND pvp.property_value_number = :volume_4000 AND pvp.product_sku IN (SELECT pvp2.product_sku FROM product_variant_properties pvp2 WHERE pvp2.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND pvp2.property_value_text = :cleaner_type))) AS has_volume_4000, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp JOIN product_variants pv ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE LOWER(pv.brand) = LOWER(:brand) AND LOWER(pv.product_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || :product_name_search || '%') AND pvp.property_key = 'volume' AND pvp.property_value_number = :volume_250 AND pvp.product_sku IN (SELECT pvp2.product_sku FROM product_variant_properties pvp2 WHERE pvp2.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND pvp2.property_value_text = :cleaner_type))) AS has_volume_250;

SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND pvp1.property_value_text = :cleaner_type JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'volume' AND (pvp2.property_value_number = :volume_4000 OR pvp2.property_value_number = :volume_250) WHERE LOWER(pv.brand) = LOWER(:brand) AND LOWER(pv.product_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || :product_name_search || '%');
